analyst_view.overall: A mid-table Segunda game at Butarque on Friday night: Luis Carrion's Leganes (15th, 18 points) host Ferran Costa's Sabadell (14th, 19 points), both about five points clear of the drop zone. Leganes have won two league games in a row, the last 3-1 at Andorra on 20 November, but Andorra played 74 minutes with ten men after Hugo Solozabal's early red card; Alvaro Morata scored there and went off after 70 minutes, and FotMob lists a muscle injury of one to two weeks, which the numbers already count (about -16% on Leganes' goals). Sabadell are winless in five league games, draw a lot (7 of 15), have one away win in seven, and sporting director Lucas Viale admitted this week to 'structural deficiencies' in the squad made worse by Gioacchini's season-ending injury (counted by the numbers). Midfielder Quadri, a near-ever-present starter, is still out after a head injury suffered almost a month ago, so Sabadell's recent numbers already reflect his absence, and Arthur is doubtful. No referee is named yet and nothing new points away from the numbers, so I stay with them on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.6 goals, 0.8 each. Leganes lose Morata, their main striker (about -16% already taken off), and Sabadell are without top scorer Gioacchini (about -12% already taken off) and midfielder Quadri, who has been out for a month; Leganes' recent scoring was helped by playing most of the Andorra game against ten men, but the numbers only add +2.8% for that form. Sabadell's away games are low-scoring, which fits, so I stay at about 1.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, split evenly. Both sides have been near their usual corner counts lately and the numbers add a little for it; Sabadell's five-man defence and direct, running style has been the same all season. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.6 cards, already high: Leganes took 27 cards in their last six (three more at Andorra) and Sabadell are also among the most booked, and the numbers add 11-16% for each side's recent run. No referee has been named yet and there is no derby or big stake beyond a mid-table scrap, so I stay at about 6.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, 14.9 for Sabadell, because Leganes have let opponents shoot a lot (104 in six), which the numbers count (+7.9%). Part of that came from Andorra's many shots while Leganes played a man up, so the trend is a little flattering, but Sabadell's thin attack away from home already sits in their own figures; I stay at about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target, 4.3 for Leganes, whose recent accuracy (33 on target in six) the numbers boost while also taking Morata's absence off their goals. Without Morata the home attack leans on Alex Millan and Naim Garcia, who both scored at Andorra; nothing points either way, so I stay at about 7.9.
